correctness.rationale: Leibniz gives D(xy)=e x+a y+(b+v)xy; the eight coefficients of D²(x),D²(y) then agree with the eight independent entries of the square of M=[[v,c,a],[u,b,e],[w,d,b+v]]. This is an invertible linear change to traceless matrices and identifies the reduced height-one locus with traceless matrices squaring to zero. Off zero, these have rank one and are parametrized by a line L=im M in a plane H=ker M and a nonzero isomorphism k³/H→L. This identifies the punctured cone with a line bundle minus its zero section over the smooth rational complete flag variety, so it is smooth, rational and irreducible of dimension 3+1. Scaling puts the zero matrix in its closure. On this locus (a,e)=0 is equivalent to M e₃=0: otherwise M e₃=(b+v)e₃ with b+v nonzero would contradict M²=0. Thus the nonzero-constant locus is dense open in the smooth punctured cone. Over F_q the flag model gives 1+(q²+q+1)(q+1)(q−1)=q⁴+q³−q. Requiring e₃∈H gives only q+1 plane choices, and hence 1+(q+1)²(q−1)=q³+q²−q; the complementary count is (q²−1)q². This holds over every indicated finite field. The scope does not extend to the full restricted nilpotent cone: the regular nilpotent matrix E₁₂+E₂₃ has nonzero square and zero fourth power.
